entry.title: /mu/ Music: Any English speakers listen to De André?
entry.content: This album is probably the best Italian language album of all time. In fact I’d go as far as to say it’s one of the best albums of all time. But due to the niche nature of the language and how much of what makes this album so amazing is the beautifully written lyrics I think it’s fallen into obscurity outside of Italy. That’s not to say musically it isn’t amazing. Every known acoustic instrument makes an appearance in this album and the second song, “L’infanzia di Maria” is probably my favorite.

We’re also pleased to announce the creation of 4chan's Vulnerability Disclosure Program —commonly known as a “bug bounty.” We hope that by providing an officially sanctioned way for security researchers to submit security-related bugs, we’ll be in a better position to detect and respond to vulnerabilities that may impact the site and its users.
